newsitem.title: FINLAND: BALTICS-EBRD CONFIDENT ON BALTIC MARKETS.
newsitem.headline: BALTICS-EBRD CONFIDENT ON BALTIC MARKETS.

text.p: The European bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) is confident of increasing interest in the markets of the Baltic states, EBRD director of the Baltic and Belarus team George Krivicky told an investment conference here Monday.
He said that the EBRD has invested 486 million ECU in 49 projects in most sectors in the Baltic states.
He noted that privatisation was speeding up in Latvia and Lithuania and that both countries had obtained credit ratings.
"These ratings are sure to, and have already, increased interest in these finanical markets," he told the conference.
